Afaik Godot doesn't create or look for any file in `android/build/assets`.

> ERROR: Can't open file from path ' '.

There must be some export plugin that's trying to open a file with empty path that's causing this error.

I might be mistaken but it seems to me that the gradle build process copies the assets you listed for export into `android/build/assets`.

I do not have any export plugins in my project, although I'm not sure if you're referring to some plugins included with godot itself?
I do however have a couple of import plugins, but I believe they're not executed during the export process

I stand corrected. You’re right, I had forgot that we keep all project files in the assets folder.
I’ll look into the issue, but without an MRP it would be harder.

Is this reproducible in older versions like 4.4.1 stable or only in 4.5 beta5? Try copying your project and testing in older versions.

Just tested and it's _partially_ reproducible in 4.4.1.
I'll let the output talk.

On 4.4.1 the engine outputs:
```
  ERROR: Can't open file from path ''.
0 param: --xr_mode_regular
1 param: --xr-mode
2 param: off
3 param: --fullscreen
```
And the apk gets exported correctly, with no missing assets

On 4.5.beta5:
```
0 param: --xr_mode_regular
1 param: --xr-mode
2 param: off
3 param: --fullscreen
4 param: --background_color
5 param: #000000
  ERROR: Can't open file from path ''.
  ERROR: Cannot create file 'res://android/build/assets/'.
```
And the APK lacks the desired assets

I'd argue that letting the editor complete the export with all the assets even if some are missing would be enough of a fix.
It's probably leaving the copy routine when this line is printed `  ERROR: Cannot create file 'res://android/build/assets/'.`

From error log, it seems like something goes wrong when initially getting the file path and it returns empty string.
Gradle export is likely failling at https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ca452113d430cb96de409a297ff5b52389f1c9d9/platform/android/export/gradle_export_util.cpp#L144-L145

Instead of using `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG`, we could switch to `WARN_PRINT_ED`, similarly on other places too. This would allow the export to complete with a warning rather than fail with an error. I’d wait to hear what the @godotengine/android team thinks about this.

> I could reproduce this only on a big project with 8gb of assets 

We should first examine the problem more closely.  

  > ERROR: Can't open file from path ''.
  > ERROR: Cannot create file 'res://android/build/assets/'.

`Mac OS Sequoia 15.6` 
I could try to reproduce it on my mac.

@h1v9 
Could you gradually reduce your assets to 7GB, 6GB, etc.? What is the minimum size the assets need to be?
With 600MB of assets I couldn't reproduce it.

> [@h1v9](https://github.com/h1v9) Could you gradually reduce your assets to 7GB, 6GB, etc.? What is the minimum size the assets need to be? With 600MB of assets I couldn't reproduce it.

I can try but I don't think it's related to the number of assets itself. This project is the porting of legacy bulk-converted assets and a couple of custom importers so it's very likely that one or more of the assets are broken or have a broken reference. However I'm unable to find out which one unless godot outputs from where the error occurs, the current error message is not very meaningful.

That's why I was suggesting to just let the editor continue the export by just signaling the error (like 4.4.1 does)

> That's why I was suggesting to just let the editor continue the export by just signaling the error (like 4.4.1 does)

[Blame](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blame/ca452113d430cb96de409a297ff5b52389f1c9d9/platform/android/export/gradle_export_util.cpp#L144-L145) --> https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/59440

This error message has been around for over three years (Godot 4.0). 
It must be due to another change if it doesn't happen in 4.4.1.



EDIT: maybe https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105984 last changes 6 months ago in the function: `FileAccess::open`

---------

> Instead of using ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG, we could switch to WARN_PRINT_ED

You could try to ignore this error, but if important files weren't exported, the app is faulty. A path is already displayed.

> [Blame](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blame/ca452113d430cb96de409a297ff5b52389f1c9d9/platform/android/export/gradle_export_util.cpp#L144-L145) --> [#59440](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/59440)
> 
> This error message has been around for over three years (Godot 4.0). It must be due to another change if it doesn't happen in 4.4.1.

It does look like there is a change somewhere else indeed. Without checking the code I'd guess that for some reason the non-existant file got into the file-copy queue. This doesn't happen in 4.4.1.

One difference I can see between the 2 versions is that the error message in 4.4.1 appears before the params listing, while on 4.5 it appears after them. This is consistent between multiple exports so something in the export process has definitely changed.
It could be a starting point to look into

However, which change could it be? I didn't dig much into the engine's source code and I know basically nothing about its codebase

> EDIT: maybe [#105984](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105984) last changes 6 months ago in the function: `FileAccess::open`

Isn't this about PCKs?
To me it looks like it should be something related to the files that get queued for copy into the assets folder.
Something like: An invalid file gets queued -> The queue processing tries to process a non existant file -> The engine stops the queue processing

The two most obvious solutions to me:
- Don't queue invalid files for copy
- Ignore invalid files when processing the queue and skip to the next one

Granted there's actually a queue there

> On 4.4.1 the engine outputs:
>  ERROR: Can't open file from path ''.

I would probably check this issue first, why the path/filename is empty.

----------

> ERROR: Cannot create file 'res://android/build/assets/'.

I think because the file name is empty, Godot 4.5 tries to open a folder (and not a file path) for writing.

> > On 4.4.1 the engine outputs:
> > ERROR: Can't open file from path ''.
> 
> I would probably check this issue first, why the path/filename is empty.

With thousands of assets I'd need godot to tell me where this empty path comes from, otherwise it's just finding a needle in a haystack. If you have any idea on how I could figure it out it would be more than welcome.

And I agree it needs to be fixed but I'd also argue the Gradle APK build shouldn't fail just because of it. "Normal" APK builds and 4.4.1 Gradle build don't fail

> 
> > ERROR: Cannot create file 'res://android/build/assets/'.
> 
> I think because the file name is empty, Godot 4.5 tries to open a folder (and not a file path) for writing.

That's definitely what's happening, but again it should be able to recover from the error

Also, try running editor with `--verbose` and exporting (`/path/to/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --path /path/to/project -e --verbose` from the terminal to open the editor). It should print much more information during the export and might help to determine which export step has empty file path.
